items.label: Introducing the LOVEVOOK Women's Laptop Bag
items.value: This women's laptop bag combines vintage charm with modern fashion, and its clean lines and solid colors make this handbag a classic. The lovevook laptop tote bag can perfectly show your elegant and beautiful style no matter where you go.

items.label: Durable & Practical Work Bag
items.value: This work tote bag is made of durable, high-quality water-resistant and scratch-resistant soft PU leather and polyester lining. Metal feet protect your bag from damage and this bag will stand the test of time.

items.label: Thickened Compartment to Protect Your Computer
items.value: The large-capacity laptop bag has multiple compartments and pockets, and is equipped with an independent thickened computer compartment to protect your computer from damage.

items.label: Multi-functional computer bag
items.value: Whether going to school, work or shopping, traveling or as a gift, this high-quality canvas laotop bag is the perfect choice. It's professional yet stylish, designed specifically for women.

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Dry clean only. Machine washable for polyester parts. Keep away from excessive moisture.
